articles.title: Cotton-Candy Planets: The Fluffiest Worlds Ever Found
articles.summary: Two newly discovered planets are literally lighter than cotton candy. TOI-791 b and c are Jupiter-sized but have densities of just 0.038 and 0.047 g/cm³. Locked in a rare orbital dance, they offer a unique chance to study how such bizarre worlds form.

articles.title: From Ocean Trash to Pavement: Hawaii's Recycled Plastic Roads
articles.summary: Hawaii is turning derelict fishing nets and household plastic waste into asphalt for roads. Early results show these recycled pavements perform well and don't release more microplastics than conventional roads. Tire wear, not road plastic, dominates microplastic pollution.

articles.title: Einstein Probe May Have Caught a Black Hole Swallowing a White Dwarf
articles.summary: The Einstein Probe X-ray telescope detected an unprecedented cosmic explosion: a rapidly brightening source that flared before a gamma-ray burst. Researchers suspect an intermediate-mass black hole tore apart a white dwarf — a first-of-its-kind observation that could reveal new black hole feeding behaviors.
